5. Irregularities carried forward from earlier sessions

  • Fixture count differs between earlier snapshots (86 SSR rows at 17:51 UTC, 92/93 from the API, 90 in the lobby app filters) — reported here, never silently reconciled.
  • Pinnacle publishes American prices on a CSV/JSON feed; decimal values on this board are derived and flagged per row.
  • Polymarket's older CS2 match markets are stale; only markets whose end date is in the future are used.
  • Some fixtures (e.g. CCT Europe series, Elisa BreakOut) are covered by only one reachable source; single-source rows are marked in the "Derived probability" column.

Data snapshot: 2026-10-13T23:09:19Z. Fixtures are enumerated from the HotSpawn Pick'ems lobby; every price comes from an external bookmaker or prediction market and is linked per row. HotSpawn's crowd "picked %" is reference context and is never used as a probability. Nothing is estimated: unsigned matches stay blank and are listed on the Flagged for review page.

Not affiliated with HotSpawn or any bookmaker. Odds move; re-check the linked source before acting on any number. If you gamble, only stake what you can afford to lose — help: BeGambleAware.
